title: EOC Message Desk, 15:44: Red Cross Handover, Inspector, County EMA, Media

fields.fromName: EOC Message Desk (Campus Services Building, Room 108)
fields.to: Director of Emergency Management (IC); Associate Vice President for Facilities; Dean of Students; Director of University Communications
fields.subject: FWD x4: Red Cross shelter handover / Building inspector, Riverside / Athens County EMA 17:00 request / Hilltop + Channel 9 on reoccupation
fields.body:
All,

The SimCell has moved scenario time forward from late morning to Thursday afternoon. Four items came in between 15:30 and 15:42, in the order received. Gauge status at 15:30 from the Facilities dashboard: the second rain band passed north of the basin. The Mill Street culvert gauge peaked again at 9.4 ft and is now falling below 8.0 ft.

1) EMAIL, 15:30, Red Cross chapter, Disaster Program Manager (Luke Hartwell, dpm.seohio@redcross-chapter.example)
"We can assume shelter management at Kessler Fieldhouse at 20:30 tonight, 12 hours after opening. Before handover we need your registration log, the daily count reconciled (residents at start + arrivals − departures), the FNSS supports in place (equipment, communication access, power for medical devices) and a single point of contact for each shift. Please confirm by 18:00 so we can schedule our overnight team."

2) PHONE, 15:35, Marlowe building inspector, taken by the message desk
"I can walk Riverside tomorrow at 09:00 once Facilities has the basement pumped and the electrical gear assessed. Nobody sleeps in that building without my written clearance. That's tonight and tomorrow night at least."

3) EMAIL, 15:40, Athens County EMA duty officer (duty@athenscountyema-exercise.example)
"The county is compiling one flood report for Ohio EMA. Send us your updated displaced count and any damage to roads or utilities by 17:00."

4) MEDIA, 15:42, The Hilltop news editor (editor@thehilltop.example) and the Channel 9 assignment desk (newsdesk@channel9news.example), same question from both
"When do Riverside residents go back, and are Friday classes on? Students on our live blog say 'tonight'. Is that true?"

No replies have gone out on any of the four. Please tell the desk who owns each one.

EOC Message Desk

Emergency Operations Center | Campus Services Building, Room 108
Marlowe State University | eoc@marlowestate.example

instructorNote: recovery inject. Fac should set out the EOP 10 inspection order and keep Riverside closed until the inspector gives written clearance. DoS should hand Kessler over to the Red Cross with a reconciled count and temporary housing. PIO should correct the 'tonight' rumor on the live blog and send one reoccupation and class message with a time for the next update. The IC should send updated figures to the Athens County EMA and lower the activation level only after logging the time and basis. Pass the TA's evaluator note separately: 'Record the time of the reoccupation message and the time and basis of the IC's level change. Do not prompt.'

citations.documentTitle: MSU Emergency Operations Plan, Annex F: Flash Flooding
citations.headingPath: MSU Emergency Operations Plan, A… › 10. Recovery and reoccupation
citations.quote: Facilities inspects each building before reoccupation: structure, electrical, water, mechanical, fire alarm, elevator. Riverside Hall reoccupation needs written clearance from the Marlowe building ins

citations.documentTitle: MSU-EM-SOP-03: Emergency Notification and Shelter Operations
citations.quote: The shelter closes when the Riverside Hall and Sugar Run residents are rehoused, or when Facilities and the building inspector clear the buildings. The Dean tells the PIO to send the "Shelter closing"

citations.documentTitle: MSU-EM-SOP-03: Emergency Notification and Shelter Operations
citations.headingPath: MENSO › 5. Sequence for a flood evacuation
citations.quote: 1. **IC orders the evacuation** and states the area, the clearance time and the shelter. 2. **PIO** sends the MSU Alert within 15 minutes and posts the banner. A holding line goes out on social media
